facts.fact: Minister Tijani said in April 2026 that the project would take the national network from the current 35,000km to roughly 125,000km, so a 35,000km national network is stated as existing; towns and owner are not given.

systems.country_label: Project BRIDGE (90,000km planned national fibre network)
systems.owner: Bridge Open Access (SPV; MoFI 25-49%, private investors 51-75%)

note: BRIDGE is financed ($800m sovereign) with rollout expected October 2026 but no contract awarded or works begun, so not building; wholesale open access is planned (expected to sell capacity), not yet operating.
